goals: Inventory every visitor surface before the ADLC colour / hierarchy transplant so token edits have a checklist, not invented IA
Name jobs, screens, zones, states, and flows a hiring visitor actually walks
Mark which palette tokens each zone already consumes so light/dark proof is relational, not a swatch strip
Model the repositioning to 'Product Designer & Design Technologist for AI and complex systems': new nav, new /practice hub, semantic-image-search case first, résumé as PDF exit

jobs.label: Decide whether Daniel is the right hire
Check design rationale and judgment (recruiter / design lead)
Scan work and open a case study
Scan research and open an exhibit

screens.title: Site chrome
screens.purpose: Fully-connected escape hatch on every page: skip link, masthead, cube, primary nav, theme toggle. Colour change lands here first — page canvas, masthead band, nav ink, focus ring.

zones.label: Skip to main content
zones.notes: tokens: link on backgroundColor; only visible on focus

zones.label: Masthead wordmark + subtitle → home
zones.notes: tokens: masthead band, header (Roboto Flex title), text (subtitle). ADLC hierarchy candidate: terminal-dark band vs cool paper page.

zones.label: Decorative 3D cube
zones.notes: tokens: border (coral faces). Pointer-events none on mobile. Not a control.

zones.label: Primary nav: home / work / research / about
zones.notes: NAV_ITEMS in lib/routes.ts. tokens: link default, surface selected, border hover, text. Active = weight + selected surface, no accent fill. /research/* stays live as deep links only.

zones.label: 2×2 theme swatch
zones.notes: tokens: surface, text, link, border cells — live proof of the four identity chips. DitheredCard hover uses border.

zones.label: Detail breadcrumb prev / title / next
zones.notes: Present only when BreadcrumbContext has a title. tokens: text, link arrows. Disabled arrows aria-hidden.

zones.label: Page canvas + main landmark
zones.notes: tokens: backgroundColor. Also hardcoded in styles/global.scss body and Radix --color-background — palette-only edits will miss this.

screens.title: Home
screens.purpose: Title + subhead ('Product Designer & Design Technologist for AI and complex systems') + three featured cases + contact CTA. First viewport of the hire job.

zones.label: Dithered headshot
zones.notes: Photographic / dithered PNG. COL-02 / COL-10: proof identity hues against this ground, not only on paper.

zones.label: Title + subhead positioning
zones.notes: Replaces the paragraph. h1 'Product Designer & Design Technologist' + subhead 'for AI and complex systems'. tokens: header (Roboto Flex), text. No inline links — AltContext exit removed (see not_doing). WRIT-02 / WRIT-07 apply to subhead copy.

zones.label: Get in touch (mailto DitheredCard)
zones.notes: tokens: text, surface inner, border hover. Primary hire action.

zones.label: Selected work list (3 cases)
zones.notes: FEATURED_SLUGS order: 1 semantic-image-search, 2 photoshelter, 3 workbay. tokens: text title/meta/desc, surface inner, link, border hover. Not the /work card grid. First card carries the designer thesis; its thumbnail is media-pending until SIS screenshots exist.

zones.label: View all projects
zones.notes: tokens: link → border hover

screens.title: Work
screens.purpose: Pyramid hub: equal-size project cards. Tufte small-multiples — content, not card size, is hierarchy.

zones.label: Project card grid
zones.notes: tokens: surface inner, text title/subtitle, inactiveBg placeholder, dithered shadow from text, border hover. Empty copy: 'No content found'.

screens.title: Research
screens.purpose: Same card grid as work, different section. Reached from /practice and deep links only (no longer a nav item; URLs stable).

zones.label: Research card grid
zones.notes: Same token set as z-work-grid. Two items today: order-book, rotation-matrices.

screens.title: Project case
screens.purpose: Read one case: sibling menu + article (title, optional masthead image, links, figures, MDX). Swipe + breadcrumb + mobile sub-nav step the pyramid. Semantic-image-search (content/projects/semantic-image-search.mdx) is the flagship case and adds the sectioned zones below.

zones.label: Section sibling list
zones.notes: tokens: inactiveBg list, surface selected, text, link hover, border selected accent. One accent surface at a time (DESIGN.md).

zones.label: Case title
zones.notes: tokens: text. Hierarchy via type, not colour.

zones.label: Optional hero figure
zones.notes: Photographic ground. COL-02 proof surface for accents.

zones.label: External link + details
zones.notes: tokens: unclassed link + coral hover; text details

zones.label: Inline figures
zones.notes: Failed images drop out. Captions inherit text.

zones.label: MDX article body
zones.notes: tokens: text; #main-content a:not([class]) uses $electric-ultramarine / $sky-blue + $coral-red hover — hardcoded hex, not t().

zones.label: Article divider (replaces MDX hr)
zones.notes: tokens: typically text/rule. Hairline — COL-09 thrift.

zones.label: SIS hero / thesis
zones.notes: Masthead figure slot. media_pending: screenshots not yet captured — render a labelled placeholder ('screenshot pending') with the same aspect box, never an empty gap (RLSE-04, Principle 11).

zones.label: At-a-glance table
zones.notes: Definition table: role, span, stack, users, status. tokens: text, hairline rules. A11Y-07: real <table>/<dl> markup.

zones.label: Problem
zones.notes: STRAT-20: obstacle before goals.

zones.label: Principles
zones.notes: Numbered list; each links to a canon rule ID where one exists.

zones.label: Core journey strip
zones.notes: pick folder → index → query → results → open. Step figures are media_pending; step labels render regardless. VIZ-17: overview stays visible while a step is read.

zones.label: Designing for incomplete truth (state comparison)
zones.notes: Six designed non-happy states shown side by side with their copy and recovery action. HAI-01: each label states the evidence that produced it. A11Y-06: state is never hue-only. media_pending: each cell shows a text card of the state copy instead of a screenshot.

zones.label: Data-rich exploration
zones.notes: Result grid / similarity readout. VIZ-17 focus+context; A11Y-06 second channel for score.

zones.label: Evaluation: technical / expert / external-user gap
zones.notes: Three columns naming what was measured, by whom, and what was not. HAI-09: no trust claim without component evidence; the external-user gap is stated, not hidden.

zones.label: Three 'evaluation changed the product' stories
zones.notes: Each: observation → change → outcome. PROD-01 outcome over output.

zones.label: Outcome & limits
zones.notes: Limits are a designed section, not an afterthought. CLM-style honesty; WRIT-02 plain words.

screens.title: Research exhibit
screens.purpose: Same SectionView chrome as project-detail; MDX may mount live exhibits (OrderBook, Cube).

zones.label: Research sibling list
zones.notes: Same Menu tokens as z-sibling-menu

zones.label: Research MDX + exhibits host
zones.notes: OrderBook uses Radix --green/--red/--gray, not site tokens. Cube uses border. Colour transplant must not silently recolour bid/ask encoding (VIZ + A11Y-06).

screens.title: Practice
screens.purpose: Hub for how judgment is made inspectable: the 'Heuristics Canon — making product and engineering judgment inspectable' essay plus a link to the research index. Answers the recruiter question 'does this person reason about design, or just ship it?'

zones.label: Practice framing (title + one-paragraph thesis)
zones.notes: tokens: header, text. STRAT-20: name the obstacle (judgment is invisible in shipped UI) before the method.

zones.label: Heuristics Canon essay
zones.notes: MDX body. Cites rule IDs versionless (e.g. [RLSE-04]). tokens: text + unclassed links → coral hover. WRIT-07: at most one not-X-but-Y pivot.

zones.label: Link to research index (/research)
zones.notes: DitheredCard. Only in-site entry to research now that it left the nav. tokens: surface, text, border hover.

zones.label: Get in touch / view work
zones.notes: Secondary exit toward exit-mailto or work-index.

zones.label: About headshot
zones.notes: Second photographic ground for COL-02 / COL-10

zones.label: About article
zones.notes: tokens: text + unclassed links (ultramarine/sky → coral)

screens.title: Résumé (PDF)
screens.purpose: Serves the résumé as a direct PDF download. Now a primary nav item ('résumé'). Leaves the HTML site.

zones.label: PDF handoff (browser viewer / download)
zones.notes: No site chrome or theme inside the PDF. A11Y-07: PDF must carry tagged headings; document title set. Back button is the only return path.

screens.title: Privacy
screens.purpose: Analytics disclosure. Linked from tests/footer copy; not in primary nav.

zones.label: Privacy policy copy
zones.notes: tokens: text + unclassed links. CLM-03: policy is a contract — colour change must not hide this route.

screens.title: Mobile prev / next
screens.purpose: Full-bleed DitheredCards under the article + swipe between siblings. Escape remains primary nav.

zones.label: Previous / next DitheredCards
zones.notes: tokens: surface, text, border hover. Empty when first/last sibling. Swipe is A11Y-15 — cards are the single-pointer alternative.

screens.title: Error boundary
screens.purpose: Render-crash recovery with a home link.

zones.label: Crash message + home link
zones.notes: tokens: inherit canvas + unclassed link. RLSE-04 designed error state.

screens.purpose: Dead URL. Escape to home / about / research.

zones.label: Recovery links
zones.notes: tokens: unclassed links on canvas. Copy still says 'Back to projects' while href is '/'.

screens.title: Mail client
screens.purpose: Leave the site to compose email.

flows.label: Land → SIS case → practice → résumé PDF → contact

open_questions: Should the masthead band go terminal-dark (#1c1d21) on the light theme to match ADLC hierarchy, or stay a sunk-paper step so the wordmark stays ink-on-paper? ([COL-04][COL-12][IDNT-05])
Radix Theme is appearance + accentColor cyan + radius medium — it leaks a second palette into OrderBook and any unstyled Radix surface. Freeze it, retune it, or isolate exhibits? ([COL-03][LAY-10])
global.scss hardcodes parchment / #1a1a1a and $electric-ultramarine / $sky-blue / $coral-red outside t(). Token-only palette edit will desync body + unclassed links. ([UI-01][REF-10])
Footer.tsx exists and is unused — is a site footer in scope for this colour pass, or still not-doing?
404 copy says 'Back to projects' but href is '/'. Fix in this pass or leave?
SIS screenshots are not captured. Does the case ship with labelled 'screenshot pending' placeholders (designed media_pending state) or is publish gated on media? ([RLSE-04][LAY-10])
Résumé link exits to a PDF with no site chrome. Should it carry a PDF affordance (arrow/label) so the context change is not a surprise? ([A11Y-20])
/research left the nav; only /practice links to it. Is one in-site path enough for the research job, or should about/work also link it?
Practice essay cites canon rule IDs versionless — do those anchors resolve publicly, or are they internal-only references?
not_doing: Importing ADLC green / yellow / pass-fail chips onto the marketing surface (COL-09 thrift; keep coral + royal blue as the only accents)
Recolouring OrderBook bid/ask Radix greens/reds as part of the site palette
Pixel comps or freeform canvas as map SSOT
Adding a site footer or resurrecting Footer.tsx unless separately scoped
exit-altcontext: AltContext.com link removed from the home hero; no external current-work exit on landing
Removing or redirecting /research/* routes (URLs stay live; only the nav entry is dropped)
Capturing SIS screenshots inside this map slice (tracked as media_pending state, not blocked)
